notes.title: Update Notes For Mar 4
notes.content:
The following optimizations have been made in this upgrade:
(1) The pathfinding algorithm has been improved, so that even in crowded situations, giants won't fail to find a path.
(2) The turret radar has been enhanced, becoming more three - dimensional and intuitive.
(3) There's no need to click on the turret to pop up the upgrade button, which optimizes the user experience. 
(4) Fix bugs.

notes.title: Update Notes For Feb.25
notes.content:
In the past few days, I've spent a significant amount of time further fixing some bugs in the game, including those related to pathfinding, interface switching, and scene details. The specific improvements are as follows:

(1) Fixed some game bugs that affected the player experience. For example, some turrets on high ground couldn't attack properly when monsters couldn't reach them.
(2) Finally, I added the captain character that I've always wanted to include. She/He will tell you the mission for each step.
(3) Added four new maps for Sophia Island. Except for the special maps that require multiple challenges, you can enjoy more battle maps in the early stage of the game.

notes.title: Update Notes 2025.2.21
notes.content:
In this version, I've fixed the bug related to level selection. Additionally, the latest progress of the story mode has been added, allowing you to directly resume your best progress from the menu. 

Moreover, I've introduced a long - awaited commander character. She only appears when chatting with you. I hope you all like it! 

Furthermore, in this update, you can now know your difficulty level during battles. Of course, if you want to change the difficulty, you'll still need to go to the settings menu, as it's not possible to modify the difficulty during combat.

notes.title: New Update (Feb.20)
notes.content:
The following improvements have been made in this version upgrade:

(1) An achievement system has been added. Whenever a player completes a level, the achievement will be recorded.
(2) The difficulty system has been improved. The highest difficulty level completed for each level will be recorded and will affect the total score.
(3) The user experience has been enhanced.

notes.title: Update notes for Feb.14
notes.content:
I'm very glad that I was able to upgrade "Giant Defense" on Valentine's Day. For this upgrade, I took into account the feedback from some veteran players. Not only have I reduced the game's size from over 4GB to 3GB, but I've also optimized the interface. Meanwhile, I've added some in - game guides.

I hope you all like this game. At the same time, I welcome you to let me know whether you enjoy playing it.

notes.title: [Giant Defense] Update Announcement
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44053658/60ce2c026c6cf3440533f1b2f76976cfcdb10bc8.png[/img]

Hello everyone! We are excited to announce a major update for [Giant Defense]! The game now supports multiple languages to allow more players to join in and explore the fantastic world of the game.

Newly supported languages:

French
Spanish
Japanese
Korean


Now you can enjoy [Giant Defense] in your preferred language, whether you are French, Spanish, Japanese, or Korean. Experience the best gaming adventure!

Don't miss this opportunity, update [Giant Defense] now, and embark on your journey of adventure! Explore alongside players from around the world, build friendships, conquer challenges, and become a legendary hero in [Giant Defense].

We appreciate your continuous support and look forward to having you play [Giant Defense] with us. If you have any suggestions or feedback, please feel free to contact us.

Have a great time playing!

[Contact Information]
If you have any questions, suggestions, or need support, please don't hesitate to contact us:
Email: freejoe2012@gmail.com

notes.title: Version updates (improve player experience)
notes.content:
This version has made a lot of improvements:

- Added the ability to select a map in the main menu
- Support to view the player's profile in the main menu
- You can now exit the game in the game.
- At the end of each battle, you can check your own score in battle
